# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.3 Far Seas & Overseas Exarchates (Slot 42, oe_far_, mode=plan_b). Generated by gen_far_seas.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Active Roman host (prefers ROM if formed, else BYZ; never rebels).
oe_far_roman_host = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = ROM
        AND = {
            tag = BYZ
            NOT = { country_exists = c:ROM }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. At least one Roman host tag exists.
oe_far_host_alive = {
    OR = {
        country_exists = c:ROM
        country_exists = c:BYZ
    }
}

# Any scope. Trajan's Canal progress read safely from Wave 3 oe_red_.
oe_far_red_canal_survey = {
    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_red_canal_stage } global_var:oe_red_canal_stage >= 1 } trigger_else = { always = no }
}

oe_far_red_canal_stage2 = {
    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_red_canal_stage } global_var:oe_red_canal_stage >= 2 } trigger_else = { always = no }
}

oe_far_red_canal_open = {
    OR = {
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_red_canal_stage } global_var:oe_red_canal_stage >= 3 } trigger_else = { always = no }
        location:suez = { has_location_modifier = oe_red_trajan_canal_open }
    }
}

# Any scope. Corridor status triggers (all guarded).
oe_far_east_open = {
    has_global_variable = oe_far_east_on
}

oe_far_west_open = {
    has_global_variable = oe_far_west_on
}

oe_far_has_east_exarch = {
    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_exarch } global_var:oe_far_east_exarch >= 1 } trigger_else = { always = no }
}

oe_far_has_west_exarch = {
    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_exarch } global_var:oe_far_west_exarch >= 1 } trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Location scope. Owned by Roman host or one of its subjects (strict has_owner guard).
oe_far_port_held_by_roman = {
    has_owner = yes
    owner = {
        OR = {
            oe_far_roman_host = yes
            AND = {
                country_exists = c:ROM
                is_subject_or_below_of = c:ROM
            }
            AND = {
                NOT = { country_exists = c:ROM }
                country_exists = c:BYZ
                is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ
            }
        }
    }
}

# Location scope. Either directly held by Roman bloc or hosts an active overseas factoria.
oe_far_port_has_post = {
    OR = {
        oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes
        has_variable = oe_far_post_active
        has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria
    }
}

# Location scope. Eligible foreign port for diplomatic/pressured factoria envoy (root = Roman host).
oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = {
    has_owner = yes
    NOT = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_port_cd }
    owner = {
        NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }
    }
}

# Location scope. Eligible foreign factoria port for 25-year enclave lease offer (.14): 10+ years established.
oe_far_port_lease_eligible = {
    has_owner = yes
    NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes }
    has_variable = oe_far_post_active
    trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_far_post_m } var:oe_far_post_m >= 120 } trigger_else = { always = no }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_lease_cd }
    owner = {
        NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = root }
    }
}

# Country scope. American foothold or vanilla colonial_nation subject (Plan B zero-override bridge).
oe_far_has_america_foothold = {
    OR = {
        any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
        any_subject = { is_subject_type = colonial_nation }
        any_subject = { any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Great Yuan Quanzhou (Zaytun) / Guangzhou Maritime Silk Road readiness (oe_ymar_ bridge).
oe_far_zaytun_ready = {
    country_exists = c:CHI
    c:CHI = {
        OR = {
            owns = location:jinjiang
            owns = location:guangzhou
        }
    }
    OR = {
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_policy } global_var:oe_ymar_policy = 2 } trigger_else = { always = no }
        oe_ymar_zaytun_open = yes
    }
}

# Any scope. Read-only bridges to vanilla EU5 1.4.9 colonial situations (zero vanilla overrides).
oe_far_tordesillas_active = {
    situation:treaty_of_tordesillas = { situation_is_active = yes }
}

    situation:columbian_exchange = { situation_is_active = yes }
}

oe_far_revolution_active = {

}

# Country scope. Core event window triggers (.1-.13).

    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_far_ev_1 }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_defer_cd }
    is_subject = no
    current_year >= 1395
    has_variable = oe_cmp_holder

        }
